schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
schema_extensions_used: RevisionEntry / GroundTruthAnnex.supersedes (new) — the revision layer, anchored on the rendered revision-history rows
AcceptanceCriterionRecord (new) — step acceptance criteria tagged with the revision that applied them and whether they are in force or superseded
out_of_schema_notes: Classification is a result of the study, so every parameter_type is 'unclassified'. No set-point or NOR of the step changed at Version 2.0, so ProcessParameter.target_value and NOR are the values of the parameter table, which are also the values in force. ProcessParameter.PAR carries the range studied, as everywhere in the corpus; the plan claims no proven acceptable range. The five multivariate parameters are also anchored on their row of the factor-levels table.
The pCO2 parameter was renamed at Version 2.0 (CO2 partial pressure (pCO2)); its concept keeps the id param:dissolved_co2 and carries the Version 1.0 name as an alias.

acceptance_criteria holds the rows of the criteria-change table (Version 1.0 analysis limits, superseded, and the Version 2.0 criteria, in force). The bioreactor quality attributes are judged per batch.

Host cell protein and residual DNA are measured on the clarified harvest but are not responses of the designs and have no intermediate acceptance criterion at this step; they appear as QualityAttribute records, as responses of the univariate study (which assays them) and as an ExplicitNonClaim.

Each AnalyticalMethod record is anchored on its methods-table row and on the procedures-table rows of its validation and of its procedure. The methods table lists one method per row, and the glycan row names three attributes, so it anchors three attribute_measured_by_method assertions.

The qualification study compares scale-down runs with manufacturing-scale batches, which is not a design, so its StudyDesign has no n_runs; the viable cell density, viability and titer it also compares have no attribute key and are not listed as responses. Studies of the step that came after Version 1.0 (the osmolality study and the augmentation runs) are not studies of this plan; PCR-003 records them as discrepancies.
parameter_impacts_attribute and parameter_does_not_significantly_impact_attribute assertions here are the plan's stated expectations from prior knowledge, not results.

The planned design matrices (Appendices A and B) are represented by their captions on the screening and response-surface StudyDesign records, not row by row. The roles table, the abbreviations and the objectives list are not represented. No rhetorical_spans: none were curated for this plan. weak_claims is empty.

process_steps.description: A fed-batch culture in which a recombinant CHO cell line secretes A-Mab into the medium. The step forms the glycan, charge variant and aggregate quality attributes of A-Mab; the culture fluid at the end of the run passes to harvest and clarification.
input_materials: cells expanded through the seed train
output_materials: culture fluid at the end of the run (harvest and clarification feed)

source_references.quote: This plan describes the Stage 1 characterization of the production bioreactor, Step 3 of the A-Mab drug substance process
The production bioreactor is a fed-batch culture in which a recombinant Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cell line secretes A-Mab into the medium over a culture of about 17 days.
The output of the step is the culture fluid at the end of the run, which passes to harvest and clarification (Step 4).
The production bioreactor is a fed-batch culture with a working volume of 15,000 L at commercial scale.
Development site | Cambridge, MA
Commercial drug substance site | Grafton, WI

statements.statement_text: Capability is judged against a Cpk of 1.33, expected in routine manufacture, and a Cpk of 1, below which an action is needed; Version 1.0 set no capability threshold.

source_references.quote: Capability is judged against a Cpk of 1.33, expected in routine manufacture, and a Cpk of 1, below which an action is needed.

statements.statement_text: Qualification by offset replaces the Version 1.0 criterion of no statistically significant difference between the scales.

source_references.quote: This replaces the Version 1.0 criterion of no statistically significant difference between the scales at p < 0.05

statements.statement_text: The model F-test must be significant at α = 0.05, lack of fit must not be significant at α = 0.05, and predicted R² must fall short of R² by no more than 0.20.

source_references.quote: The model F-test must be significant at α = 0.05, lack of fit must not be significant at α = 0.05, and predicted R² must fall short of R² by no more than 0.20.

statements.statement_text: The grid of the analysis at the set-points is 201 points; Version 1.0 stated 81 points for both analyses.

source_references.quote: Version 2.0 states the grid of the analysis at the set-points as the 201 points that the analysis uses. Version 1.0 stated 81 points for both analyses.

statements.statement_text: The Version 1.0 title block carried 2026-07-24, the approval date of the Version 1.0 reports, in place of the approval date of the plan.

source_references.quote: The Version 1.0 title block carried 2026-07-24, the date on which the Version 1.0 reports were approved, in place of the date on which this plan was approved

statements.statement_text: The pCO2 parameter is named CO2 partial pressure (pCO2), and the units are given in full; no value changes.

source_references.quote: The pCO2 parameter is named CO2 partial pressure (pCO2), and the units are given in full for osmolality (mOsm/kg), dissolved oxygen (% air saturation), initial viable cell concentration (10⁶ cells/mL), basal medium concentration (× standard) and nutrient feed-1 volume (% of working volume)

statements.statement_text: High mannose glycans are those whose processing stops before N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase I, not glycans on which processing never began.

source_references.quote: They are the glycans whose processing stops before N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase I, not glycans on which processing never began.

statements.statement_text: The factors, ranges, set-points, designs, sampling and the other decision rules are those of Version 1.0.

source_references.quote: The factors, their ranges and set-points, the designs, the sampling and the other decision rules are those of Version 1.0.

statements.statement_text: What INV-002 changed in the analysis of the bioreactor studies is recorded in PCR-003 as discrepancies from the plan.

source_references.quote: What it changed in the analysis of the bioreactor studies is recorded in the bioreactor report PCR-003 as discrepancies from this plan.

statements.statement_text: Version 2.0 adds a lower limit of 18.0 % for acidic variants.

source_references.quote: Version 2.0 adds a lower limit of 18.0 % for acidic variants.

statements.statement_text: The criteria in force are derived without data from the bioreactor studies.

source_references.quote: The criteria in force are derived without data from the bioreactor studies.

statements.statement_text: The directions recorded on the platform (X-Mab, Y-Mab, Z-Mab) are carried into the study as expectations, and the magnitudes are not.

source_references.quote: The directions recorded on the platform are carried into this study as expectations, and the magnitudes are not.

statements.statement_text: No purification step retains one neutral glycoform in preference to another, so the distribution of the neutral glycoforms in the drug substance is decided in the bioreactor.

source_references.quote: The distribution of the neutral glycoforms in the drug substance is therefore decided in the bioreactor.

statements.statement_text: Aggregate and acidic variants formed in the culture can be reduced by the purification train but not reversed.

source_references.quote: Aggregate and acidic variants are also formed in the culture, and the purification train can reduce that burden but cannot reverse it.

statements.statement_text: The amount by which one parameter moves a glycan attribute is expected to depend on the levels of the others.

source_references.quote: The amount by which one parameter moves a glycan attribute is therefore expected to depend on the levels of the others.

statements.statement_text: The net direction in which a parameter moves the acidic variant level is not predictable from the chemistry alone.

source_references.quote: The net direction in which a parameter moves the acidic variant level is therefore not predictable from the chemistry alone.

statements.statement_text: Raising pCO2 moves the Golgi enzymes in the same direction as lowering the culture pH.

source_references.quote: Dissolved carbon dioxide equilibrates with bicarbonate and lowers the cytosolic pH, so raising pCO2 moves the Golgi enzymes in the same direction as lowering culture pH.

statements.statement_text: None of initial viable cell concentration, basal medium concentration and nutrient feed-1 volume is expected to move a glycan attribute at a fixed culture age.

source_references.quote: None of these three parameters is therefore expected to move a glycan attribute at a fixed culture age.

statements.statement_text: The critical attributes of the step are afucosylation, galactosylation, high mannose and aggregate.

source_references.quote: For this step the critical attributes are afucosylation, galactosylation, high mannose and aggregate.

statements.statement_text: Acidic variants and residual DNA have very low criticality, and their drug substance criteria still apply.

source_references.quote: Acidic variants and residual DNA have very low criticality, and their drug substance criteria still apply

statements.statement_text: High mannose carries the highest Tool #1 score of the step.

source_references.quote: High mannose carries the highest Tool #1 score of the step.

statements.statement_text: Afucosylation and galactosylation are scored high because A-Mab acts mainly through antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity.

source_references.quote: Afucosylation and galactosylation are scored high because A-Mab acts mainly through antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity.

statements.statement_text: Acidic variants are measured by icIEF in the plan.

source_references.quote: The register states the criterion for acidic variants for measurement by CEX or icIEF, and this plan measures them by icIEF

statements.statement_text: 5 of the 9 parameters were assigned to multivariate study (culture pH, culture temperature, CO2 partial pressure (pCO2), osmolality and culture duration) and 4 to univariate study (dissolved oxygen, initial viable cell concentration, basal medium concentration and nutrient feed-1 volume).

source_references.quote: For the production bioreactor, 5 of the 9 parameters were assigned to multivariate study and 4 to univariate study

statements.statement_text: The range studied of every parameter extends beyond its NOR at both ends, at 1.5 to 2.5 times the width of the NOR.

source_references.quote: The width of the range studied is between 1.5 and 2.5 times the width of the NOR.

statements.statement_text: Scale-dependent parameters are set so that process performance at small scale matches performance at full scale.

source_references.quote: They are set so that process performance at small scale matches performance at full scale

statements.statement_text: pCO2 is controlled to the level of each run in the scale-down model and studied as a factor over a range that spans the levels the commercial vessel reaches.

source_references.quote: pCO2 is therefore controlled to the level of each run in the scale-down model and is studied as a factor in its own right, over a range that spans the levels the commercial vessel reaches.

statements.statement_text: The carbon dioxide stripping of the commercial vessel is not matched, a departure from PCMP-001 §5.

source_references.quote: The carbon dioxide stripping of the commercial vessel is not matched, which departs from PCMP-001 §5 for this reason.

statements.statement_text: The offset of each output is reported with its two-sided 90 % confidence interval.

source_references.quote: It is reported with its two-sided 90 % confidence interval

statements.statement_text: The conclusion for an output is whether it meets its criterion at all 81 combinations of NOR low, set-point and NOR high of the 4 response-surface factors.

source_references.quote: The conclusion for an output is whether it meets its criterion at all 81 combinations of NOR low, set-point and NOR high of the 4 response-surface factors.

statements.statement_text: The model is qualified for an output when the conclusion is the same with the offset at either end of its confidence interval.

source_references.quote: The model is qualified for an output when this conclusion is the same with the offset at either end of its confidence interval.

statements.statement_text: The qualification decision is made at analysis, because the conclusion for an output needs the response-surface model.

source_references.quote: The decision whether the model is qualified for an output is made at analysis, because the conclusion for the output needs the response-surface model.

statements.statement_text: The offset is estimated at the set-points only; its use across the range studied is an assumption.

source_references.quote: The offset is estimated at the set-points only.

statements.statement_text: The three glycan responses of any one run come from a single preparation and are not independent measurements.

source_references.quote: so the three glycan responses of any one run are not independent measurements

statements.statement_text: The screening model has 16 terms in 19 runs, which leaves 1 degree of freedom for lack of fit against 2 for pure error.

source_references.quote: The model has 16 terms and the design has 19 runs, which leaves 1 degree of freedom for lack of fit against 2 for pure error.

statements.statement_text: The response-surface data are fitted to the full quadratic model, 15 terms in 28 runs.

source_references.quote: The response-surface data are fitted to the full quadratic model in the 4 factors carried forward, which has 15 terms in 28 runs.

statements.statement_text: The response-surface model is the predictive model of the step, and every prediction, every PAR and the operating region come from it.

source_references.quote: The response-surface model is the predictive model of this step, and every prediction, every PAR and the operating region come from it.

statements.statement_text: Capability at commercial scale is estimated by simulating 2,000 batches and will be confirmed against the commercial batches of Stage 2.

source_references.quote: Capability at commercial scale is estimated by simulating 2,000 batches

statements.statement_text: At resolution V all main effects and two-factor interactions of the screening design are estimable clear of one another.

source_references.quote: At resolution V all 5 main effects and all 10 two-factor interactions are estimable clear of one another

statements.statement_text: pCO2 and osmolality are separate factors of the screening design.

source_references.quote: pCO2 and osmolality are separate factors of the screening design.

statements.statement_text: Osmolality is not carried into the response-surface design; its range studied is the narrowest relative to its NOR, at 1.6 times its width.

source_references.quote: The parameter not carried forward is osmolality, whose range studied is the narrowest of the 5 relative to its NOR, at 1.6 times the width of the NOR.

statements.statement_text: If screening identifies a different subset of active parameters, the response-surface design will be amended before execution.

source_references.quote: If screening identifies a different subset, the design will be amended before execution

statements.statement_text: The range supported by the univariate study is conditioned on the other parameters being at their set-points.

source_references.quote: The range it supports for each parameter is therefore conditioned on the other parameters being at their set-points

statements.statement_text: A run with a Cook's distance above 4/n is examined by deletion; the flag is 0.14 for the 28 runs of the response-surface design.

source_references.quote: and it is 0.14 for the 28 runs of the response-surface design.

statements.statement_text: The NORs must lie inside the declared operating region.

source_references.quote: The NORs must lie inside the declared region.

statements.statement_text: A parameter has a PAR for each attribute its model shows it changes, and the range carried into the control strategy is their intersection.

source_references.quote: A parameter has a PAR for each such attribute, and the range carried into the control strategy is their intersection

statements.statement_text: PCMP-001 and SOP-4001 set no numerical threshold for a high risk, a practically relevant effect or a wide PAR.

source_references.quote: PCMP-001 and SOP-4001 set no numerical threshold for a high risk, a practically relevant effect or a wide PAR.

statements.statement_text: A Cpk of at least 1.33 is expected of a critical quality attribute in routine manufacture.

source_references.quote: A Cpk of at least 1.33 is expected of a critical quality attribute in routine manufacture.

statements.statement_text: A Cpk below 1 requires an action in the control strategy.

source_references.quote: A Cpk below 1 requires an action in the control strategy.

assertions.assertion_text: A culture pH closer to the isoelectric point of the antibody is expected to raise the aggregate level in the harvest.

source_references.quote: A higher titer, a longer culture and a culture pH closer to the isoelectric point of the antibody each raise the aggregate level in the harvest.

assertions.assertion_text: A longer culture is expected to raise the aggregate level in the harvest.

source_references.quote: A higher titer, a longer culture and a culture pH closer to the isoelectric point of the antibody each raise the aggregate level in the harvest.

assertions.assertion_text: A higher culture pH is expected to raise deamidation, the main source of acidic variants; the net direction is not predictable from the chemistry alone.

source_references.quote: The rate of deamidation rises with pH and with temperature, and the time available for it rises with the culture duration.

assertions.assertion_text: A higher culture temperature is expected to raise deamidation, the main source of acidic variants; the net direction is not predictable from the chemistry alone.

source_references.quote: The rate of deamidation rises with pH and with temperature, and the time available for it rises with the culture duration.

assertions.assertion_text: A longer culture duration is expected to raise deamidation, the main source of acidic variants; the net direction is not predictable from the chemistry alone.

source_references.quote: The rate of deamidation rises with pH and with temperature, and the time available for it rises with the culture duration.

assertions.assertion_text: Galactosylation is expected to fall as the culture ages.

source_references.quote: Galactosylation is therefore expected to fall as the culture ages and the harvested pool accumulates late-culture antibody.

assertions.assertion_text: A longer culture is expected to carry more host cell protein (hcp) into the harvest.

source_references.quote: Viability falls late in a fed-batch culture, so a longer culture carries a larger amount of both into the harvest.

assertions.assertion_text: A longer culture is expected to carry more residual dna into the harvest.

source_references.quote: Viability falls late in a fed-batch culture, so a longer culture carries a larger amount of both into the harvest.

assertions.assertion_text: Dissolved oxygen is not expected to move afucosylation measurably across the range studied.

source_references.quote: The culture is not limited by oxygen at either end of the range studied, so neither the specific growth rate nor the glycan distribution is expected to move measurably across it.

assertions.assertion_text: Dissolved oxygen is not expected to move galactosylation (total %gal) measurably across the range studied.

source_references.quote: The culture is not limited by oxygen at either end of the range studied, so neither the specific growth rate nor the glycan distribution is expected to move measurably across it.
